from PIL import Image
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
import os

WS = r"<WORKSPACE>"
os.makedirs(os.path.join(WS, "out"), exist_ok=True)

# --- Job 1: feed photo 1080x1350 with magenta balloon fully inside ---
img = Image.open(os.path.join(WS, "launch.jpg"))
W, H = img.size  # 3000x2000
# balloon bbox from detection: (2350,500)-(2750,900), center (2549,700)
bw, bh = 400, 400
cx, cy = 2549, 700
target_ratio = 1080 / 1350  # 0.8
# crop width = 1080/1350 * height; choose crop size so balloon fits with margin
# balloon needs at least bw x bh; add margin
margin = 120
need_w = bw + 2 * margin  # 640
need_h = bh + 2 * margin  # 640
# crop must be 0.8 ratio: w = 0.8*h
# try height = need_h -> width = 0.8*640=512 < need_w, so width-limited
h = need_w / target_ratio  # 800
w = int(h * target_ratio)  # 640
# center on balloon, clamp to image
x0 = int(cx - w / 2)
y0 = int(cy - h / 2)
x0 = max(0, min(x0, W - w))
y0 = max(0, min(y0, H - h))
crop = img.crop((x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + h))
out = crop.resize((1080, 1350), Image.LANCZOS)
out.save(os.path.join(WS, "out", "feed-photo.jpg"), quality=92)
print("feed-photo saved, crop:", (x0, y0, x0 + w, y0 + h))

# --- Job 2: fill permit form and flatten ---
reader = PdfReader(os.path.join(WS, "permit-form.pdf"))
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.append_pages_from_reader(reader)
# fill fields
fields = {
    "organizer": "Tidewater Studio",
    "event_date": "2026-12-05",
    "location": "North Cove Lawn",
    "attendees": "40",
}
for page in writer.pages:
    if "/Annots" in page:
        for a in page["/Annots"]:
            o = a.get_object()
            name = o.get("/T")
            if name in fields:
                o[writer._add_object if False else "/V"] = fields[name]
                o["/AS"] = None if False else o.get("/AS")
                # set appearance
                from pypdf.generic import NameObject, TextStringObject
                o[NameObject("/V")] = TextStringObject(fields[name])
# flatten: remove form fields after filling
writer.remove_images = False
# pypdf flatten: use clone_from? Actually pypdf has no flatten; use set_need_appearances False and remove annots
# Simplest: after filling, remove the AcroForm and annots to make it non-editable
# We'll write out then strip form
with open(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"), "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("permit-filled saved (pre-flatten)")

# Flatten: remove AcroForm and field annots
r2 = PdfReader(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"))
w2 = PdfWriter()
w2.append_pages_from_reader(r2)
# remove AcroForm
if "/AcroForm" in w2._root_object:
    del w2._root_object["/AcroForm"]
for page in w2.pages:
    if "/Annots" in page:
        del page["/Annots"]
with open(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"), "wb") as f:
    w2.write(f)
print("permit-filled flattened")

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject, TextStringObject
import os

WS = r"<WORKSPACE>"
fields = {
    "organizer": "Tidewater Studio",
    "event_date": "2026-12-05",
    "location": "North Cove Lawn",
    "attendees": "40",
}

reader = PdfReader(os.path.join(WS, "permit-form.pdf"))
writer = PdfWriter(clone_from=reader)
writer.update_page_form_field_values(writer.pages[0], fields)
# remove AcroForm so fields can't be edited; drop annots (values already drawn? no - need appearance)
# pypdf update_page_form_field_values sets /V but appearance streams may be missing;
# flatten by keeping annots with /AP? Safer: keep AcroForm but the brief says flattened so answers can't be edited.
# Remove AcroForm and annots only if appearances exist; they don't, so instead keep annots but remove AcroForm
# -> viewers show /V text? Not without AP.
# Best: use pypdf's flatten? Not available. Use update_page_form_field_values(auto_regenerate=False)
# then remove AcroForm but keep annots with generated AP.
writer2 = PdfWriter(clone_from=reader)
writer2.update_page_form_field_values(writer2.pages[0], fields, auto_regenerate=False)
# auto_regenerate=False means it will generate appearance streams
if "/AcroForm" in writer2._root_object:
    del writer2._root_object[NameObject("/AcroForm")]
for page in writer2.pages:
    if "/Annots" in page:
        del page[NameObject("/Annots")]
with open(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"), "wb") as f:
    writer2.write(f)
print("saved")
# verify
r = PdfReader(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"))
print("text:", r.pages[0].extract_text())
print("acroform:", "/AcroForm" in r.trailer["/Root"])

--- tmp/do_pdf2.py ---
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject
import os
WS = r"<WORKSPACE>"
fields = {
    "organizer": "Tidewater Studio",
    "event_date": "2026-12-05",
    "location": "North Cove Lawn",
    "attendees": "40",
}
reader = PdfReader(os.path.join(WS, "permit-form.pdf"))
writer = PdfWriter(clone_from=reader)
# fill and generate appearance streams so values are visible
writer.update_page_form_field_values(writer.pages[0], fields, auto_regenerate=False)
# remove AcroForm so the form is no longer editable; keep annots (with /AP) so values render
if "/AcroForm" in writer._root_object:
    del writer._root_object[NameObject("/AcroForm")]
with open(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"), "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("saved")
r = PdfReader(os.path.join(WS, "out", "permit-filled.pdf"))
p = r.pages[0]
print("fields:", r.get_fields())
print("acroform:", "/AcroForm" in r.trailer["/Root"])
ann = p.get("/Annots") or []
print("annots:", len(ann))
for a in ann:
    o = a.get_object()
    print(" ", o.get("/T"), "V=", o.get("/V"), "AP=", "/AP" in o)

--- tmp/find_balloon.py ---
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open(r"<WORKSPACE>\launch.jpg")
print("size:", img.size, "mode:", img.mode)
a = np.asarray(img.convert("RGB")).astype(int)
r, g, b = a[..., 0], a[..., 1], a[..., 2]
# magenta: high R, low G, high B
mask = (r > 150) & (g < 120) & (b > 150) & ((r - g) > 60) & ((b - g) > 60)
ys, xs = np.where(mask)
print("magenta px:", len(xs))
if len(xs):
    print("bbox:", xs.min(), ys.min(), xs.max(), ys.max())
    print("center:", int(xs.mean()), int(ys.mean()))
